brief: What triggered the compaction of the conversation context, set on the span of the operation that compacted it.
additional_context: Set on the span of the request that writes the compacted context, such as the model call that summarizes the conversation. Its presence marks that span as a compaction. Requests that later run on the compacted context set `gen_ai.conversation.compacted` instead. Common values are `manual` (requested by the user), `threshold` (the context reached a configured limit) and `overflow` (recovering from a context window overflow).
